judgments.value_text: SK hynix stated that HBM3E produced at volume would be supplied to a customer from late March 2024.
judgments.summary: At the March 19, 2024 vintage, SK hynix had begun HBM3E volume production and described customer supply as beginning from late March. The qualitative target is preserved exactly as contemporaneous Judgment; later evidence must not rewrite it into a precise date.

metadata.timing_guard: Do not translate 'late March' into an invented exact date.
metadata.reality_guard: The March 19 statement is not itself proof that later customer supply had already occurred.
metadata.qualification_guard: Customer-supply timing is not a generic platform-qualification claim.
